string.text: Hide the classic Body Health System HUD (including psy bar) and status icons by default, then show them reactively. BHS appears on limb damage and/or a hold key. Status icons appear per toggle when not grey (yellow+), with an optional grey grace period. Turn Medik HUD tab Status icons ON if Medik is installed — its hide loop will otherwise clear the strip. Per-limb BHS control is not available.
Keep the classic BHS silhouette, bars, and psy bar hidden unless damage flash or the hold key shows them.
Show the classic BHS HUD while this key is held. No key bound by default.
Briefly show classic BHS when you take limb damage. Duration below; 0 seconds disables the flash even if this is on.
How long BHS stays visible after limb damage. Further hits refresh the timer. 0 = off.
If all limbs heal to full during a damage flash, remaining show time is clamped to this value. 0 = hide immediately when full.
Manage the status icon strip: hide by default, then show only opted-in icons below (and while the status hold key is down).
Show opted-in status icons while held, including grey. No key bound by default.
Allow the radiation status icon when yellow or worse. Grey uses the grace slider at the bottom.
Allow the bleed status icon (Actor Damage Balancer) when yellow or worse.
Allow the hunger status icon when yellow or worse.
Allow the thirst status icon when yellow or worse.
Allow the sleep status icon when yellow or worse.
Seconds to keep a grey (mild) opted-in icon visible after it becomes grey, then hide it. 0 = never show grey. Yellow+ clears the timer.
